project.name: TseFamily Renovate Config
project.summary: TseFamily Renovate relay preset that extends the Sylphx org-wide Renovate policy while keeping family-specific overrides in default.json.
goals: Provide the TseFamily Renovate relay preset for repositories that inherit the Sylphx org-wide dependency update policy.
Keep TseFamily-specific Renovate overrides explicit in default.json.
Preserve SylphxAI/renovate-config as the upstream source of truth for base Renovate policy.
nonGoals: Own the Sylphx org-wide Renovate base policy or package-manager strategy.
Encode one application repository's dependency exceptions as a global TseFamily default without a documented reason.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: tsefamily-renovate-relay
owns.description: The default.json Renovate preset consumed by TseFamily repositories and any intentionally family-wide overrides.

owns.name: relay-documentation
owns.description: README documentation that explains the upstream Sylphx policy relationship and local override boundary.

doesNotOwn: Sylphx org-wide Renovate base policy, shared dependency management doctrine, or package-manager strategy.
Individual application repository dependency exceptions unless intentionally promoted into a family-wide override.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not copy the Sylphx base Renovate policy into this repository instead of extending the upstream preset.
Do not add one repository's dependency exception as a TseFamily-wide default without documenting why it is family-wide.
Do not make applications depend on undocumented Renovate behavior outside default.json and README.md.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/renovate-config.

delivery.deployPath: No repository-local CI workflow is present; changes should be validated with JSON parsing and Renovate dry-run or affected-repository readback when policy changes are material.
delivery.productionProof: Preset changes require JSON validation plus evidence that consuming repositories can resolve the preset and, for material policy changes, Renovate dry-run or affected-repo readback.

gaps.description: Add a lightweight CI workflow for JSON validation and Renovate config validation.
Document Renovate dry-run or affected-repository readback evidence required after material preset changes.
Link this relay explicitly to the upstream ADR or doctrine record that defines Sylphx Renovate ownership.
